## Walkthrough

A new GitHub Actions workflow file adds automated fuzzing for jamforge on a daily schedule and manual dispatch, delegating to a reusable workflow with configurable matrix options (tiny/full) and runtime parameters.

## Changes

**Jamforge Fuzz Workflow**

| Layer / File(s) | Summary |
|---|---|
| **Workflow Triggers & Metadata** <br> `.github/workflows/jamforge-fuzz.yml` | Workflow runs daily at 00:00 UTC, on manual dispatch, and on PRs that modify this workflow file. |
| **Permissions** <br> `.github/workflows/jamforge-fuzz.yml` | Grants read-only access to repository contents and write access to issues. |
| **Fuzzing Job Configuration** <br> `.github/workflows/jamforge-fuzz.yml` | `graymatter-source` job uses the reusable `graymatter-fuzz-source` workflow with `jamforge` target, executes docker commands with templated socket path, runs two matrix configurations (`tiny`/5000 blocks and `full`/500 blocks), 23-hour timeout, 10 runs per configuration, and mentions `philoniare` on completion. |

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 1 (Trivial) | ⏱️ ~3 minutes

## Possibly related PRs

- [FluffyLabs/jam-testing#17](https://github.com/FluffyLabs/jam-testing/pull/17): Adds similar graymatter-source job configuration using the same reusable workflow pattern with matching inputs.
- [FluffyLabs/jam-testing#9](https://github.com/FluffyLabs/jam-testing/pull/9): Related workflow addition that also uses the graymatter-fuzz-source reusable workflow with jamforge target.
- [FluffyLabs/jam-testing#28](https://github.com/FluffyLabs/jam-testing/pull/28): Modifies workflow socket-path arguments in related fuzzing workflows.
